scope: Publication integrity/static checks only; not business tests, provider access or deployment
preparation_notes: The first static checker invocation exceeded the Node child-process default output buffer while reading a WOFF2 blob (ENOBUFS). Only the publisher checker buffer was raised to 16 MiB; no product source or evidence bytes were changed.
limitations: Heuristic screening plus component publication review; does not prove absence of all possible sensitive data. Source/evidence SHA are different and identified in remote receipt.
